-- Every night at 3.30. The computer n8n runs on may be asleep then, so
-- the trigger fires every hour, and this lets a run through only when the
-- latest 3.30 has passed since the last cleanup in retention_runs, which Run
-- now writes too. Otherwise nothing comes out and the run ends here.
WITH here AS (
    SELECT now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS now
),
slot AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN planned <= now THEN planned ELSE planned - interval '1 day' END AS at
      FROM (SELECT now, date_trunc('day', now) + time '03:30' AS planned FROM here) x
),
last_run AS (
    SELECT (SELECT max(ran_at) FROM retention_runs) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS at
)
SELECT to_char(slot.at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due_since
  FROM slot, last_run
 WHERE coalesce(last_run.at, '-infinity') < slot.at;

-- Takes away the text of articles collected longer ago than
-- raw_text_retention_days, except what a newsletter or an editor still has,
-- and old answers from the AI's cache. Writes a line in retention_runs and
-- returns it, so this run's output says what went. See
-- db/init/25-retention.sql.
SELECT * FROM clean_up_raw_text();
